title.en: Printed-row question: Where does commercial placement start in the catalogue
title.zh: 先看已印出的行：商业浇筑在目录里从哪里开始

description.en: At Electric 20, if the pipe is inside 120 m / 40 m, the stone is 1–2 cm and the site can feed 22 kW. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai repeats “building and commercial concrete placement” on Electric 20, 30, 40, 50, the low-pressure 40 and 60, and HBT80-16. Electric 60 adds the high-rise phrase. Electric 80 adds high-rise and long-distance pumping.
description.zh: 从电动20开始，前提是管路在 120 m / 40 m 内、石子是 1–2 cm、现场能供 22 kW。河北品锦机械（邢台）在电动20、30、40、50、低压40、低压60和 HBT80-16 上重复了“建筑与商业混凝土浇筑”。电动60加上高层这句话。电动80加上高层与长距离泵送。农村型号没有使用商业这句话。HBT80-16 是商业还是基建？它自己的工况句是建筑与商业浇筑，50 m³/h、水平 120 m。900 m 的长水平基建是电动80。不包括。砂浆、石膏和目录中的混凝土喷涂在 /products/spraying-machines。

question.en: Is HBT80-16 commercial or infrastructure, under the outline “Description”?
question.zh: 在“描述”这一节里，HBT80-16 是商业还是基建？

answer.en: Its own scenario line is building and commercial placement, at 50 m³/h and 120 m horizontal. Long horizontal infrastructure at 900 m is Electric 80.
answer.zh: 它自己的工况句是建筑与商业浇筑，50 m³/h、水平 120 m。900 m 的长水平基建是电动80。

question.en: Does commercial placement include spraying, under the outline “History”?
question.zh: 在“沿革”这一节里，商业浇筑包括喷涂吗？

answer.en: No. Mortar, plaster and listed concrete spraying are on /products/spraying-machines.
answer.zh: 不包括。砂浆、石膏和目录中的混凝土喷涂在 /products/spraying-machines。

question.en: Is there a named commercial project, under the outline “Use in construction”?
question.zh: 在“在工程中的用法”这一节里，有具名的商业项目吗？

answer.en: No. The catalogue names the application, not a building.
answer.zh: 没有。目录写的是工况，不是一座楼。
